label: direct insecticide resistance bioassay
definition: An insecticide resistance bioassay without the use of any synergist.

label: topical application insecticide resistance bioassay
definition: An insecticide resistance bioassay by adding insecticide directly to the thorax of the insect.

label: direct insecticide resistance diagnostic assay
definition: A direct insecticide resistance assay that at preset insecticide dosage scoring mortality to determine resistance of a population.

label: insecticide resistance dose response assay
definition: A direct insecticide resistance assay in which an insect population is exposed to a range of insecticide dosage scoring mortality to determine resistance.

label: insecticide resistance time response assay
definition: A direct insecticide resistance assay to determine resistance as a consequence of the time of exposure to insecticide.

label: Centre for Disease Control and Prevention bottle bioassay
definition: A direct insecticide resistance diagnostic assay performs in a glass bottle coated with insecticides for detecting resistance to insecticides in vector populations.

label: WHO cone kit diagnostic assay
definition: A direct insecticide resistance diagnostic assay uses WHO cone kit.

label: WHO paper kit diagnostic assay
definition: A direct insecticide resistance diagnostic assay uses WHO paper kit.

label: WHO larvicide diagnostic assay
definition: A direct insecticide resistance diagnostic assay tests survival of larvae in a medium supplemented with insecticide.

label: insecticide resistance dose response by bottle assay
definition: An insecticide resistance dose response assay that performs in a glass bottle coated with insecticides.

label: insecticide resistance dose response by survival of larvae assay
definition: An insecticide resistance dose response assay that tests survival of larvae in a medium supplemented with insecticide.

label: insecticide resistance dose response by WHO paper kit assay
definition: An insecticide resistance dose response assay using WHO paper kit.

label: insecticide resistance time response by bottle assay
definition: An insecticide resistance time response assay that is performed in a glass bottle coated with insecticides, with the presence of a synergist.

label: insecticide resistance time response by WHO paper kit assay
definition: An insecticide resistance time response assay using WHO paper kit, with the presence of a synergist.

label: insecticide resistance by amplification refractory mutation system assay
definition: An insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay that detects any mutation involving single base changes or small deletions using amplification refractory mutation system (ARMS). The ARMS is based on the use of sequence-specific PCR primers that allow amplification of test DNA only when the target allele is contained within the sample. Following an ARMS reaction the presence or absence of a PCR product is diagnostic for the presence or absence of the target allele. It can be used to analyze human genomic DNA for one or more mutations.

parents.label: insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay

label: insecticide resistance by primer introduced restriction analysis PCR assay
definition: An insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay that detects Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms (SNPs) using PCR technique and mismatched primers that is close to the mutation of interest and digested the PCR productions using restriction enzymes.

parents.label: insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay

label: insecticide resistance by nested polymerase chain reaction assay
synonyms: gene mutation detection by nested PCR
definition: An insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay that detects gene mutation based on nested polymerase chain reaction technique.

parents.label: insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay

label: insecticide resistance by ligase detection reaction assay
definition: An insecticide resistance assay that is based on monitoring known mutations using ligase detection reaction exquisitely discriminate between a mismatched and complementary DNA helix.

parents.label: insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay

label: insecticide resistance by ligase detection reaction-fluorescent microsphere assay
definition: An insecticide resistance by ligase detection reaction assay that uses fluorescently labeled conserved probes in ligase detection reaction.

parents.label: insecticide resistance by ligase detection reaction assay

label: insecticide resistance by PCR amplification of specific alleles assay
synonyms: allele-specific amplification and amplification refractory mutation system
definition: An insecticide resistance assay that is based on monitoring known mutations by PCR amplification of specific alleles to detect polymorphic or mutant alleles.

parents.label: insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay

label: insecticide resistance by fluorogenic PCR assay
definition: An insecticide resistance assay that is based on monitoring known mutations by PCR technique that uses target specific probes labeled with fluorogenic chromophores to detect gene mutation.

parents.label: insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay

label: insecticide resistance by PCR-RFLP assay
definition: An insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay based on restriction fragment length polymorphism assay.

parents.label: insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay

label: insecticide resistance by short interspersed elements PCR assay
definition: An insecticide resistance assay that is based on monitoring known mutations by PCR amplification of short interspersed elements (SINEs).

parents.label: insecticide resistance by monitoring known mutations assay

label: pathogen detection assay
definition: An organism detection assay that detects pathogens.

label: VectorTest assay
definition: A pathogen detection assay that identifies the presence or absence of specific peptide epitopes of circumsporozoite (CS) protein of the most important Plasmodium falciparum and two strains (variants 210 and 247) of the more widespread Plasmodium vivax using a dipstick wicking test strip.

label: pathogen detection by Rapid Analyte Measurement Platform assay
definition: A pathogen detection assay that is based on Rapid Analyte Measurement Platform (RAMP) technology to quantify immunologically active substances.

label: pathogen detection by loop-mediated isothermal amplification assay
definition: A pathogen detection assay that is based on loop-mediated isothermal amplification.

label: blood meal assay
definition: An assay that analyzes the specimen taken from blood meal fed organism, such as insect.

label: blood meal by counter current immunoelectrophoresis assay
definition: A blood meal assay that uses a counter current immunoelectrophoresis technique.

label: DNA based blood meal finger printing assay
synonyms: DNA based blood meal finger printing
definition: A DNA fingerprinting assay that uses DNA extracted from blood meal fed organism, such as insect.

label: organism detection by size assay
definition: An organism detection assay that is based on the size of organism.

label: organism detection by cross mating assay
definition: An organism detection assay that is based on genetic crossings between specimens collected in the field to determine whether fertile progeny is produced.

label: organism detection by cytological chromosome examination assay
definition: An organism detection assay that is based on analysis of polytene chromosomes through cytological examination of the banding pattern of the species.

label: organism detection by isoenzyme electrophoresis assay
definition: An organism detection assay that is based on electrophoresis to determine the isozymes that are present in a specific population to determine the species.

label: organism detection by morphological examination assay
definition: An organism detection assay that is based on examination of morphology and the use of specific taxonomic keys to determine the species of the specimen.

label: organism detection by PCR assay
definition: An organism detection assay that is based on PCR.

label: organism detection by specific DNA hybridization assay
definition: An organism detection assay that is based on DNA hybrdization.

label: organism detection by salinity tolerance assay
definition: An organism detection assay of mosquito species that is on the basis of mosquito survival depending on the salt concentration in the water used to lay their eggs to differentiate between morphologically very similar species.

label: PRO-cap
definition: Precision nuclear run-on and sequencing to detect Pol II initiation sites

label: ribosomal RNA-depleted RNA sequencing assay
definition: An RNA-seq assay in which highly abundant ribosomal RNAs are removed from total RNA before sequencing, resulting in more efficient transcript/gene detection.

label: metatranscriptome sequencing assay
definition: An RNA-seq assay that determines the RNA sequence of microbial transcripts from a microbioal community of mixed species from a given microbiome.

label: lipid profiling assay
definition: An analyte assay assay that detects and identifies lipids resulting from biochemical and cellular metabolism.

label: single-nucleus ATAC-seq
definition: An ATAC-seq assay in which single nuclei are isolated from frozen tissue samples, through a protocol designed to maximally preserve nucleus integrity during sample processing and optimize transposase-mediated fragmentation of chromatin in individual nuclei.

parents.label: assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing

label: 16s ribosomal gene sequencing assay
definition: An amplicon sequencing assay in which the amplicon is derived from universal primers used to amplify the 16S ribosomal RNA gene from isolate bacterial genomic DNA or metagenomic DNA from a microbioal community. Resulting sequences are compared to reference 16S sequence databases to identify or classify bacteria present within a given sample.

parents.label: taxonomic diversity assessment by targeted gene survey

label: single-cell ATAC-seq
definition: An ATAC assay designed to robustly map the accessible genome of individual cells, using sequencing integrated into a programmable microfluidics platform, in order to provide insights into cell-to-cell variation in accessibility profiles.

parents.label: assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing

label: microbiome protein expression profiling assay
definition: A protein expression profiling assay of microbial proteins extracted from a microbioal community of mixed species from a given microbiome.

label: cytokine assay
definition: An analyte assay to study presence, concentration, or amount of cytokines.

label: amplicon sequencing assay
definition: A sequencing assay in which a DNA or RNA input molecule is amplified by PCR and the product sequenced.

label: whole virome sequencing assay
definition: A whole metagenome sequencing assay that intends to provide information on multiple genome sequences from different viruses present in the same input sample.

label: single-value binding of antibody with reporter to antigen assay
definition: An assay that detects the linking of antigens and antibodies via special signaling mechanisms, such as EIA, ELISA, chemiluminescence, etc. that produces one measure (quantitative or qualitative) of the analyte of interest

label: fluorescence imaging-based apoptosis assay
definition: A type of cytometry assay in which fluorescent dyes are used to label and detect proteins or structures associated with molecular processes of apoptosis.

label: fluorescence imaging-based cell proliferation assay
definition: A type of cell proliferation assay in which fluorescent dyes are ued to label and detect proteins or structures that can be used to count cells.

label: fluorescence imaging-based cell cycle state assay
definition: A type of cytometry assay in which fluorescent dyes are used to label and detect proteins or structures associated with particular cell cycle states.

label: fluorescence imaging-based cell viability assay
definition: A type of cytometry assay in which fluorescent dyes are used to label and detect proteins or structures associated with cell viability.

label: fluorescence imaging-based drug synergy assay
definition: A type of cytometry assay in which fluorescent dyes are used to label and detect proteins or structures to determine if drugs applied to cells in combination have a greater effect together than the sum of their separate effects.

label: fluorescence imaging-based cell morphology assay
definition: A type of cytometry assay in which fluorescent dyes are used to label and detect proteins or structures in order to determine cell morphology.

label: fluorescence imaging multiplex cytological profiling
definition: A type of cytometry assay in which fluorescent dyes are used to stain seven major cellular components followed by automatic image capture and analysis which extracts shape, texture, and intensity parameters.

label: protein state assay
definition: A type of assay that measures the quantity and/or identity of proteins in their modficied and unmodified states where modifications include phosphorylation, methylation, acetylation, etc.

label: fluorescence imaging-based protein phosphorylation state assay
definition: A type of protein state assay that employs high-throughput microscopy to measure levels of proteins in different phosphorylation states.

label: mass spectrometry-based protein state assay
definition: A type of protein state assay that employs mass spectrometry to measure levels of proteins in different phosphorylation states.

label: targeted, drug-modulated, mass spectrometry-based protein phoshporylation-state assay
definition: A type of mass spectrometry protein state assay that measures levels of a targeted set of proteins in different phosphorylation states in response to drug perturbations.

label: reverse phase protein array profiling assay
synonyms: reverse phase lysate array profiling assay
definition: A type of protein state assay where tissue or cell samples are lysed and then spotted onto a slide which is probed with antibodies specific to proteins with and without post-translational modifications.

label: SWATH-MS protein profiling assay
synonyms: sequential window acquisition of all theoretical mass spectra protein profiling assay
definition: A type of mass spectrometry assay using a data-independent acquisition method to identify target peptides.

label: tandem mass tag mass spectrometry assay
definition: A type of tandem mass spectrometry where isotopomer labels are employed for accurate quantification and identification of specific proteins.

label: fluorescence imaging-based reporter gene assay
definition: A type of reporter gene assay that employs fluorescence imaging to detect a reporter gene's expression.

label: global chromatin profiling by mass spectrometry assay
definition: A type of epigenetic modification assay that employs targeted quantitative mass spectrometry to profile modifications of the core histones of chromatin.

label: kinase inhibitor assay
definition: A type of assay that identifies compounds that inhibit the activity of kinases.

label: KINOMEscan assay
definition: A type of proprietary kinase inhibitor assay that and employs a panel of kinases against which one can test compounds for their selectivity and potency in interactions with kinases, without the need to add ATP to the reactions.

label: KiNativ assay
definition: A type of proprietary in situ kinase inhibitor assay that employs biotinylated acyl phosphates of ATP and ADP.

label: landmark transcript profiling assay
definition: A type of transcription profiling assay in which a set of landmark transcripts that have been determined to provide a comprehensive profile of cell activity, plus numerous steady-state controls, are assayed via ligation-mediated amplification followed by capture on fluorescently labeled microspheres followed by detection of fluorescence.

label: microenvironment microarray assay
definition: A type of cytometry assay where cells are incubated for three days with a standardized set of extracellular matrix proteins in combination with various ligands creating varying microenvironment perterbations for the cells. Immunofluorescent imaging of cells is used to measure features such as morphology, metabolism, cell cycle, and nuclear activity.

label: microwestern meso-scale quantitative western blot assay
definition: A western blot assay that provides a high-throughput, sensitive, and quantitative measurement of proteins from numerous samples via an array of small western blots on a single sheet of nitrocellulose.

label: positive/negative ion switching metabolite profiling assay
definition: A type of metabolic profiling assay which employs a hybrid dual quadrupole linear ion trap mass spectrometer for steady-state profiling of endogenous polar metabolites from organic extractions from biological samples.

label: cyclic immunofluoroescence assay
definition: A type of microscopy assay resulting in highly multiplexed immunofluorescence imaging through sequential rounds of imaging followed by fluorophore inactivation.

label: multiplex bead-based protein state immunoassay
definition: A type of protein state assay in which antibodies attached to different colored beads and fluorescent reporter dye labels are used in a multiplexed mixture to assay for proteins in specific states.

label: capture Hi-C assay
definition: A Hi-C assay in which a selection step is performed on ligated fragments in order to enrich for ligation products containing specific regions of interest.

label: magnetic resonance imaging assay
definition: An imaging assay in which nuclear magnetic resonance is used to produce information about the interior structure and composition of an input material entity.

label: computed tomography imaging assay
definition: An imaging assay that uses a series of X-ray images to produce information about the interior structure and composition of an input material entity.

label: positron emission tomography imaging assay
definition: An imaging assay in which positron-emitting radionuclides are used to visualize functional processes of an input material entity.

label: T cell receptor repertoire sequencing assay
definition: A sequencing assay that determines the sequences of DNA or RNA molecules that encode the repertoire of T cell receptors within an input sample.

label: B cell receptor repertoire sequencing assay
definition: A sequencing assay that determines the sequence of a DNA or RNA molecules that encode the repertoire of B cell receptors within an input sample.

label: ferritin assay
definition: An assay that measures ferritin

label: fibrinogen assay
definition: An assay that measures fibrinogen

label: iron assay
definition: An analyte assay that measures the abundance of iron

label: ionized calcium assay
definition: An analyte assay that measures the abundance of ionized calcium

label: transferrin assay
definition: An analyte assay that measures the abundance of transferrin

label: uric acid assay
definition: An analyte assay that measures the abundance of uric acid

label: globulin assay
definition: An analyte assay that measures the abundance of globulin

label: myelocyte assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of myelocytes

label: metamyelocyte assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of metamyelocytes

label: hematocrit assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the proportion of red blood cells

label: promyelocyte assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of promyelocytes

label: basophil assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of basophils

label: neutrophil assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of neutrophils

label: eosinophil assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of eosinophils

label: lymphocyte assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of lymphocytes

label: monocyte assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of monocytes

label: reticulocyte assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of reticulocytes

label: macrophage assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of macrophages

label: platelet assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the abundance and/or characteristics of platelets

label: fluorogenic PCR assay
definition: A polymerase chain reaction assay that uses target specific probes labeled with fluorogenic chromophores.

label: genotyping by PCR assay
definition: A genotyping assay that uses polymerase chain reaction.

label: cleavage under targets and release using nuclease assay
definition: A type of DNA sequencing assay employing in situ chromatin profiling in which antibody-targeted controlled cleavage by micrococcal nuclease releases specific protein-DNA complexes into the the supernatant for sequencing.

label: cleavage under targets and tagmentation
definition: A type of DNA sequencing assay employing in situ chromatin profiling in which a chromatin protein is bound in situ by a specific antibody, which then tethers to a protein A-Tn5 hyperactive transposase fusion protein (pA-Tn5) loaded with sequence adapters. Activation of pA-Tn5 results in factor-targeted tagmentation, generating fragments ready for PCR enrichment and DNA sequencing.

label: coma severity assay
definition: A physical examination of an organism that has the objective to determine the severity of coma in a patient.

label: Plasmodium gametocyte detection assay
definition: An assay that detects Plasmodium gametocytes in a specimen.

label: malaria rapid diagnosis assay
definition: An assay that is quick and easy in the diagnosis of malaria by detecting evidence of malaria parasites (antigens) in human blood.

label: parasite detection assay
definition: An assay that detects parasite in a specimen.

label: feces microbiology assay
definition: An organism detection assay that detects microorganisms in a feces specimen.

label: blood assay
definition: An assay that has a blood specimen as evaulant.

label: falcivax rapid diagnostic test
definition: A parasite detection assay that can quickly establish the diagnosis of P. falciparum or P. vivax malaria infection by detecting the antigens in a person's blood.

label: optimal-IT rapid diagnostic test
definition: A parasite detection assay that is rapid, sensitive, and able to differentiate between P. falciparum and other malaria parasites.

label: urine assay
definition: An assay that has a urine specimen as evaluant.

label: parasite species identification by PCR assay
definition: A parasite detection by PCR assay that identifies the species of parasite.

label: parasite detection by PCR assay
definition: A parasite detection assay that uses PCR.

label: organismal body temperature measurement assay
definition: An assay that detects body temperature of an organism.

label: autofluorescence assay
definition: A fluorescence detection assay in which the light that is naturally emitted by a sample is visualized after excitation of the sample with light at a suitable wavelength.

label: autofluorescence microscopy assay
definition: An autofluorescence assay in which the light that is naturally emitted by a sample is visualized via microscopy after excitation of the sample with light at a suitable wavelength.

label: bulk assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing
definition: An assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing in which the sample that is sequenced is derived from a collection of cells, such as a tissue sample or entire cell culture, and therefore provides results representative of the aggregate of sample cells.

parents.label: assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing

label: bulk RNA-seq assay
definition: An RNA-seq assay in which the sample that is sequenced is derived from a collection of cells, such as a tissue sample or entire cell culture, and therefore provides results representative of the aggregate of sample cells.

label: multiplexed fluorescent antibody imaging assay
definition: An imaging assay in which multiple cycles consisting of fluorescent labeling, imaging, and fluorophor deactivation are used to detect multiple proteins and their locations in a given sample of tissues or cells.

label: Cell DIVE multiplexed imaging assay
definition: A multiplexed fluorescent antibody imaging assay that involves an iterative staining, imaging and dye inactivation workflow for over 60 biomarkers on a single fixed tissue section.

label: co-detection by indexing assay
definition: A multiplexed fluorescent antibody imaging assay that involves a highly multiplexed analysis of up to 40 proteins in a tissue using cyclic detection of DNA-indexed antibody panels.

label: fluorescence in-situ hybridization assay
definition: An in-situ hybridization assay in which fluorescently labeled molecules are used to localize specific DNA or RNA sequences.

label: decoding amplified targeted transcripts with fluorescence in situ hybridization assay
definition: A fluorescence in-situ hybridization assay which involves multiplex in situ digital quantification of targeted RNA transcripts in fresh or frozen tissue providing an understanding of the spatial organization of different cell types.

label: imaging mass cytometry assay
definition: A cytometry time of flight assay in which molecules of interest on or in cells are imaged through a system in which samples are labeled with multiple different rare-earth tagged antibodies. The sample is then ablated with a laser and the labeled material is detected by cytometry time of flight mass spectrometry.

label: liquid chromatography mass spectrometry assay
definition: A mass spectrometry assay where a sample mixture is first separated by liquid chromatography before being converted into ions which are characterized by using mass spectrometry based on their mass-to-charge ratio and relative abundance.

label: lightsheet fluorescence microscopy assay
definition: A fluorescence microscopy that involves capturing of photons emitted by fluorophores excited with a thin sheet of laser light in a sample only in a relatively narrow plane by a detection objective oriented perpendicularly to the light sheet and imaged onto a detection device such as a CCD camera.

label: matrix assisted laser desorption ionization imaging mass spectrometry assay
definition: A mass spectrometry assay that involves collection of spatially resolved mass spectra of a sample during microscopy where a pulse laser is used to produce both ionisation and vaporization. The sample is held in a matrix (such as dihydrobenzoic acid) to protect it from direct laser illumination and to separate the sample molecules. The spectra are used to visualise the spatial distribution of biomolecules by their molecular masses.

label: multiplexed ion beam imaging assay
definition: A cytometry time of flight assay in which molecules of interest on or in cells are imaged through a system in which samples are labeled with multiple different rare-earth tagged antibodies. A primary ion beam is ued to rasterize sections under vacuum, releasing showers of secondary ions detected by cytometry time of flight mass spectrometry.

label: nanospray desorption electrospray ionization assay
definition: A mass spectrometry assay that analyzes organic and biological molecules on a substrate by desorption of an analyte into a solvent bridge formed between two capillaries and the analysis surface. One capillary supplies solvent to create and maintain the bridge, while the second capillary transports the dissolved analyte from the bridge to the mass spectrometer. A high voltage applied between the inlet of mass spectrometer and the primary capillary creates a self-aspirating nanospray.

label: nanodroplet processing in one pot for trace samples assay
definition: A protein expression profiling assay in which proteomics sample processing is performed in nanoliter volumes. Flow cytometry or laser microdissection is employed to isolate a small population or single cells into a nanoPOTS chip. Then, liquid chromatography mass spectrometry is used to measure the global protein expression.

label: periodic acid-Schiff staining assay
definition: A histological assay which is used on tissue samples to demonstrate the presence of carbohydrates and carbohydrate compounds such as polysaccharides, mucin, glycogen, or fungal cell wall components.

label: single cell combinatorial indexing assay for transposase-accessessable chromatin using sequencing
definition: An assay for transposase-accessible chromatin that uses sequencing which involves single cell combinatorial indexing ('sci-') strategy where nucleic acids from each of many cells are uniquely tagged through several rounds of split-pool barcoding which enables identification of single cells without single cell isolation.

parents.label: assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing

label: single-cell combinatorial indexing RNA sequencing assay
definition: A single-cell RNA sequencing assay that involves single cell combinatorial indexing ('sci-') strategy to profile the transcriptomes of single cells or nuclei without single cell isolation.

label: sequential fluorescence in-situ hybridization assay
definition: A fluorescence in-situ hybridization assay that involves ultra-resolution imaging of cell activity by targetting thousands of single molecules with fluorescent probes which find and hybridize with complementary DNA or RNA sequences in the tissue sample, thus enabling identification of those molecules directly in single cells with their spatial context preserved.

label: slide-seq assay
definition: An RNA-seq assay that involves transfer of RNA from tissue sections onto a surface covered in DNA-barcoded beads with known positions, allowing the locations of the RNA to be inferred by sequencing.

label: single-nucleus chromatin accessibility and mRNA expression sequencing assay
definition: A single-nucleus RNA sequencing assay that involves joint profiling of accessible chromatin and RNA within the same cells which enables direct matching of transcriptional regulation to its outputs.

label: single-nucleus RNA sequencing assay
definition: A RNA-seq assay that is used for profiling gene expression in individual nuclei with optimized next generation sequencing (NGS) technologies. This allows the RNA-seq profiling of cell types that are more vulnerable to the tissue dissociation process, and that are therefore underrepresented in the final data set in single cell sequencing.

label: gas chromatography mass spectrometry assay
definition: A mass spectrometry assay combining mass spectrometry and gas chromatography for the qualitative as well as quantitative determination of compounds.

label: SOMAscan assay
definition: An analyte assay that uses aptamers to detect protein analytes in serum.

label: Olink assay
definition: A proximity extension assay that uses quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) technology to determine the concentration/presence of proteins using a high-multiplex, high-throughput protein biomarker platform. The assay utilizes two distinct oligonucleotide-labeled antibodies (‘probes’) that bind at different sites for each detected protein. When the two probes are in close proximity, a new PCR target sequence is formed by a proximity-dependent DNA polymerization event. The resulting sequence is subsequently detected and quantified using standard real-time PCR.

label: proximity extension assay
definition: An analyte assay that uses quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) technology to determine the concentration/presence of an analyte or analyte complex.

label: antigen detection by cytometric bead array assay
definition: A cytometric bead array assay in which a series of beads are coated with antibodies specific to antigens of interest. Antigens of interest attach to antibodies on the beads. Fluorescent labeled secondary antibodies are used to detect the antigens of interest.

label: antibody detection by cytometric bead array assay
definition: A cytometric bead array assay that detects antigen-specific antibodies. In the assay a series of beads are coated with antigens which capture antibodies specific to the antigens. Fluorescent labeled secondary antibodies are used to detect the antibodies of interest.

label: 3D molecular structure determination assay
definition: An assay that determines the 3-dimensional configuration of a molecular entity or molecular complex.

label: electron-microscopy 3D molecular structure determination assay
definition: A 3D molecular structure determination assay that uses electron microscopy imaging.

label: 3D cell structure determination assay
definition: A 3D structure determination assay that determines the 3-dimensional configuration of a cell.

label: 3D neural cell structure determination assay
definition: A 3D cell structure determination assay that determines the 3-dimensional configuration of a neural cell.

label: neuron morphology assay
definition: A 3D neural cell structure determination assay that determines the 3-dimensional configuration of a neuron.

label: mosaicism with repeat frameshift genetic sparse labeling
definition: A 3D neural cell structure determination assay where sparse and stochastic methods are used to label genetically-defined neurons.

label: neuron morphology reconstruction assay
definition: A neuron morphology assay where the morphology or structure of a neuron is represented. Often, this assay is a combination of different assays (sparse labelling, fluorescent labeling, fMOST).

label: B cell epitope assay
definition: An immune epitope assay that characterizes the structrue of an antibody-epitope complex, or measures the binding of an antibody receptor to epitope, or the immune response process resulting from such a binding event or the recognition of the epitope.

label: T cell epitope assay
definition: An immune epitope assay that characterizes the structrue of an epitope-T cell receptor complex, or measures the binding of a T cell receptor to epitope, or the immune response process resulting from such a binding event or the recognition of the epitope.

label: assay measuring quantitative binding of a MHC:ligand complex
definition: An assay that detects the binding of a MHC molecule with a ligand, and produces a quantitative measurement of the binding as an output.

parents.label: assay measuring binding of a MHC:ligand complex

label: assay measuring quantitative binding of an antigen:antibody complex
definition: An assay that detects the binding of an antigen with an antibody, and produces a quantitative measurement of the binding as an output.

parents.label: assay measuring binding of a B cell epitope:antibody complex

label: assay measuring quantitative binding of an epitope:MHC:TCR complex
definition: An assay that detects the binding of a MHC:epitope complex with a T cell receptor, and produces a quantitative measurement of the binding as an output.

parents.label: assay measuring binding of a T cell epitope:MHC:TCR complex

label: albumin concentration assay
definition: An albumin assay that measures the concentration of albumin in a specimen.

label: basophil percentage assay
definition: A basophil assay that measures the percentage of basophils in a specimen.

label: calcium cation concentration assay
definition: A calcium cation assay that measures the concentration of calcium cations in a specimen.

label: chloride concentration assay
definition: A chloride assay that measures the concentration of chloride in a specimen.

label: cholesterol concentration assay
definition: A cholesterol assay that measures the concentration of cholesterol in a specimen.

definition: An assay for identifying DNA binding sites for a protein by fusing it to Dam methylase, and expressing it so that bound DNA gets methylated. The methylated DNA can then be isolated and analyzed.

label: DNase Hi-C assay

label: micro-C assay

label: single cell combinatorial indexing Hi-C assay

label: single nucleus Hi-C assay
definition: A Hi-C assay performed on isolated nuclei.

label: single cell Hi-C assay
definition: A Hi-C assay performed on a single cell.

label: bulk Hi-C assay
definition: A Hi-C assay in which the sample that is sequenced is derived from a collection of cells, such as a tissue sample or entire cell culture, and therefore provides results representative of the aggregate of sample cells.

label: multi-contact Hi-C assay
definition: A Hi-C assay that assesses interactions between multiple DNA fragments rather than only pairwise interactions as in traditional Hi-C. The experimental procedure of cross-linking, digestion, and ligation is performed similarly to traditional Hi-C, but after DNA is purified a long-read library is produced in which many ligated fragments may be contained in a single molecule. The library is then sequenced on a long read sequencer.

label: transposase-mediated analysis of chromatin looping assay
definition: A DNA sequencing assay designed to detect interacting genomic regions. Rather than the traditional Hi-C approach of digestion and proximity ligation, the procedure involves transposase-mediated insertion of an oligonucleotide linker between the pair of interacting regions.

label: split-pool recognition of interactions and tag extension assay
definition: A sequencing assay designed to detect multi-way interactions between nucleic acids. The procedure involves crosslinking nuclei, and then splitting the lysate among wells in a 96-well or other multi-well plate. A different barcode is ligated to the fragments in each well, and the lysates are pooled together again. This sequence of splitting, tagging, and re-combining is repeated several times so that fragments with the same sequences of barcodes represent fragments that have co-associated throughout the experiment. Finally, a sequencing library is constructed and high-throughput sequencing is performed.

label: DNA split-pool recognition of interactions and tag extension assay
definition: A split-pool recognition of interactions and tag extension (SPRITE) assay that only assays interactions between regions of genomic DNA.

parents.label: split-pool recognition of interactions and tag extension assay

label: RNA-DNA split-pool recognition of interactions and tag extension assay
definition: A split-pool recognition of interactions and tag extension (SPRITE) assay in which RNA in the cross-linked complexes is converted to cDNA before the initial splitting step, allowing analysis of RNA-DNA interactions.

parents.label: split-pool recognition of interactions and tag extension assay

label: genome architecture mapping assay
definition: A DNA sequencing assay designed to analyze 3D chromatin structure without relying on digestion and ligation. The procedure involves cryosectioning samples in random orientation, and then single nuclear profiles are isolated by laser microdissection. Each nuclear profile then undergoes high-throughput sequencing, and subsequent analysis can generate a matrix of inferred proximity between genomic regions.

label: mapping RNA-genome interactions assay
definition: A nuclear ligation assay for probing RNA-DNA interactions in the nucleus. Nuclei are crosslinked, and RNA fragments are ligated to proximal DNA fragments via a special linker molecule. After reverse transcription, high-throughput sequencing is performed.

label: forced cough assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to cough forcefully.

label: speech test assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to understandably repeat spoken sentences.

label: finger to finger assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to touch index fingers together in front of the sternum without oscillation for a specified duration of time

label: nose to finger assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to touch their own nose and then touch an examiners finger in front of them and then touch their own nose once more.

label: dysmetria assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to accurately touch a moving target with their finger and then touch their own chin a number of times in a row.

label: rapid alternating hands assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to alternate the forearm between pronation and suppination as quickly as possible during a specified duration of time

label: finger taps assessment

label: heel along shin assessment

label: heel to shin assessment

label: muscle atrophy assessment
definition: An observational assesment of an individual's muscle tissue loss due to inactivity or disease.

label: muscle weakness assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to perform muscle movement to overcome gravity or physical resistence.

label: vibratory sense assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to sense vibration.

label: position sense assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to sense the position of a finger or toe that has been manipulated by minimal random movements.

label: deep tendon reflex assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's muscle contraction when a muscle is triggered by a signal from a muscle spindle in response to a stimulus applied to a specific trigger point on the body.

label: limits of stability assessment
definition: The functional assessment of an individual's ability to maintain balance, posture or upright stability.

label: sitting posture assessment
definition: A limits of stability assessment designed to assess an individual's ability to maintain unsupported posture while sitting over a given time period.

label: stance feet apart assessment
definition: A limits of stability assessment designed to assess an individual's ability to maintain a stable stance with feet 20 cm apart.

label: stance feet apart assessment, with eyes closed
definition: A limits of stability assessment designed to assess an individual's ability to maintain a stable stance with their eyes closed.

label: stance feet together assessment
definition: A limits of stability assessment designed to assess an individual's ability to maintain a stable stance with feet together.

label: stance feet together assessment, with eyes closed
definition: A limits of stability assessment designed to assess an individual's ability to maintain a stable stance with feet together and eyes closed.

label: tandem stance assessment
definition: A limits of stability assessment designed to assess an individual's ability to maintain a stable stance with feet in tandem placement.

label: stance on one foot assessment
definition: A limits of stability assessment designed to assess an individual's ability to maintain a stable stance on one foot.

label: tandem walk assessment
definition: A limits of stability assessment designed to assess an individual's ability to maintain balance while walking in a straight line placing steps in tandem.

label: gait assessment
definition: A limits of stability assessment designed to assess an individual's manner or pattern of walking.

label: bulbar assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's lower cranial nerve function via proxy of facial muscle performance.

label: spontaneous speech assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to articulate spoken words.

label: limb coordination assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to coordinate limb movement.

label: upper limb coordination assessment
definition: A limb coordination assessment designed to assess an individual's ability to coordinate upper limb movement.

label: lower limb coordination assessment
definition: A limb coordination assessment designed to assess an individual's ability to coordinate lower limb movement.

label: nervous system functionality assessment
definition: A functional assesment of an individual's nerve performance. Specifically the nerves connecting the sensory and motor structures with the central nervous system.

label: upright stability assessment
definition: A functional assessment of an individual's ability to maintain upright body posture.

label: deep tendon reflex assessment of the knee joint
definition: A deep tendon reflex assessment of an individual's reaction to stimulus applied to a knee joint.

label: observational assessment of individual
definition: A physical examination of an organism through visual assesment.

label: deep tendon reflex assessment of the ankle joint
definition: A deep tendon reflex assessment of an individual's reaction to stimulus applied to an ankle joint.

label: deep tendon reflex assessment of the tendon of biceps brachii
definition: A deep tendon reflex assessment of an individual's reaction to stimulus applied to a tendon of biceps brachii.

label: deep tendon reflex assessment of the brachioradialis
definition: A deep tendon reflex assessment of an individual's reaction to stimulus applied to a brachioradialis.

label: tandem mass spectrometry assay
definition: A mass spectrometry assay that uses two or more analyzers separated by a region in which ions can be induced to fragment by transfer of energy (frequently by collision with other molecules).

label: ELISA measuring Orientia tsutsugamushi IgM antibody
definition: An enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that detects the IgM antibody that binds Orientia tsutsugamushi.

label: microarray assay measuring Dengue IgM antibody
definition: A microarray assay that detects the IgM antibody that binds Dengue.

label: microarray assay measuring NS1
definition: A microarray assay that detects NS1.

label: analytical chromatography measuring Chikungunya IgM antibody
definition: Analytical chromatography that detects the IgM antibody that binds Chikungunya.

label: ELISA measuring Chikungunya IgM antibody
definition: An enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that detects the IgM antibody that binds Chikungunya.

label: microarray ELISA measuring Chikungunya IgM antibody
definition: An enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that uses a microarray as the solid support and detects the IgM antibody that binds Chikungunya.

label: proximity ligation-assisted ChIP-seq
definition: A chromosome conformation capture assay in which proximity ligation is conducted in nuclei prior to chromatin shearing and immunoprecipitation. Immunopreciptation with an antibody that targets a transcription factor or histone modification allows for selection and enrichment of specific genomic regions for investigation of long-range chromosomal interactions.

label: skin of body microbiology assay
definition: An organism detection assay that detects microorganisms in a skin of body specimen.

label: bone marrow microbiology assay
definition: An organism detection assay that detects microorganisms in a bone marrow specimen.

label: nasal aspirate microbiology assay
definition: An organism detection assay that detects microorganisms in a nasal aspirate specimen.

label: cell proliferation assay using carboxyfluorescein succinimidyl ester staining
definition: A cell proliferation assay that uses carboxyfluorescein succinimidyl ester staining to detect cell division.

label: cell viability assay
definition: A cytometry assay which measures the number of living cells in a population.

label: cell viability assay using Annexin V staining
definition: A cell viability assay that uses Annexin V staining to detect apoptotic cells.

label: cell culture assay
definition: An assay that has cell culture as an input.

label: serum anti-Epstein-Barr virus antibody level assay
definition: An antigen specific antibodies assay that is meant to detect antibodies that bind to Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) antigens in a serum sample.

label: serum anti-cytomegalovirus antibody level assay
definition: A CMV antibody assay that has serum as an input.

label: single cell B cell receptor repertoire sequencing assay
definition: A B cell receptor repertoire sequencing assay that determines the sequence of DNA or RNA molecules that encode the repertoire of B cell receptors that can be traced to a single cell of origin.

parents.label: B cell receptor repertoire sequencing assay

label: single cell T cell receptor repertoire sequencing assay
definition: A T cell receptor repertoire sequencing assay that determines the sequence of DNA or RNA molecules that encode the repertoire of T cell receptors that can be traced to a single cell of origin.

parents.label: T cell receptor repertoire sequencing assay

label: quartz crystal microbalance assay
definition: An assay that measures the change in frequency of a quartz crystal resonator resulting from the addition or removal of a small mass of a ligand specifically binding at the surface of the resonator.

label: quartz crystal microbalance assay measuring the dissociation constant [KD] of a B cell epitope:antibody complex
definition: A quartz crystal microbalance assay that measures the dissociation constant [KD] of an antigen binding with an antibody.

parents.label: assay measuring the dissociation constant [KD] of a B cell epitope:antibody complex

label: multiplexed error-robust fluorescence in situ hybridization assay
definition: A fluorescence in-situ hybridization assay that uses combinatorial FISH labeling with error resistant encoding schemes for highly multiplexed single-molecule imaging.

label: single molecule fluorescence in situ hybridization
definition: A fluorescence in-situ hybridization assay that detects single RNA molecules in fixed cells, allowing for both the quantification and localization at the single-cell level and single-molecule resolution.

label: electron microscopy assay determining the 3D structure of a T cell epitope:MHC:TCR complex
definition: An electron-microscopy 3D molecular structure determination assay that characterizes the 3-dimensional molecular structrue of a T cell epitope:MHC:TCR complex.

parents.label: 3D molecular structure determination assay of a T cell epitope:MHC:TCR complex

label: electron microscopy assay determining the 3D structure of a MHC:ligand complex
definition: An electron-microscopy 3D molecular structure determination assay that characterizes the 3-dimensional molecular structrue of a MHC:ligand complex.

parents.label: 3D molecular structure determination assay of a MHC:ligand complex

label: in vitro CRISPR screen assay
definition: An assay in which cells expressing a Cas system are infected with a library of guide RNAs with the intent of causing a perturbation at the target of the guide RNAs.

label: in vitro CRISPR screen using single-cell RNA-seq
definition: An in vitro CRISPR screen assay that uses single-cell RNA-Seq to detect induced changes in gene expression.

label: in vitro CRISPR screen using flow cytometry
definition: An in vitro CRISPR screen assay that uses flow cytometry to detect induced changes in gene expression of the targeted genes.

label: single-nucleus methylcytosine and transcriptome sequencing assay
definition: A DNA methylation profiling by high throughput sequencing assay that measures the cytosine DNA methylation and gene expression signature of single nuclei.

parents.label: DNA methylation profiling by high throughput sequencing assay

label: chromatin accessibility assay
definition: An assay that determines which regions of a DNA molecule are in the form of euchromatin and thus able to make direct physical contact with (i.e. are accessible to) other molecules such as RNA polymerase, transcription factors, etc.

label: m6A-MTase sequencing assay
definition: A DNA methylation profiling assay in which chromatin stencils are created by treating nuclei with m6A methyltransferase (MTase) and then sequenced using single-molecule circular consensus sequencing to identify regions of accessible DNA at nucleotide resolution.

label: assessment of learning and/or memory response in an organism
definition: A nervous system functionality assessment of learning or memory in an organism

label: assessment of startle response in an organism
definition: A nervous system functionality assessment of auditory startle response in an organism in an anechoic chamber by exposing to sound.

label: grip strength assay
definition: A nervous system functionality assessment that uses the grip strength of a lab animal to measure neuromuscular function.

label: assay of organismal behavior
definition: A physical examination to assess behavior quality in a live organism.

label: organism development assay
definition: A physical examination of an organism that provides information about some developmental process in that organism.

label: reproductive assay
definition: A physical examination of an organism that provides information about some reproductive process in that organism.

label: vital sign assay
definition: An assay of a organism to measure basic physiological functions such as breathing, pulse, etc. (phylum bilateral).

label: blood pressure assay
definition: A vital sign assay that determines the blood pressure (force of blood against the artery walls) of an organism.

label: heart rate variability assay
definition: A pulse rate assay that measures beat to beat variability in heart beats.

label: pulse rate assay
definition: A vital sign assay that measures the heart beat rate of an organism.

label: respiratory assay
definition: A vital sign assay that measures the quality of respiration / respiratory system of an organism

label: cell differentiation assay
definition: A cytometry assay that monitors the differentiation stage of cells in culture.

label: cell based DNA damage assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures DNA damage in cells.

label: natural killer cell count assay
definition: A cytometry assay to determine the number of natural killer cells in a specimen

label: natural killer cell percentage assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the percentage of natural killer cells in a specimen.

label: sperm count assay
definition: A cytometry assay to count the number of mature sperm in a specimen.

label: survey administration assay
definition: An assay that obtains data from one or more participants by using a survey or questionnaire

label: clinical history collection assay
definition: A clinical assay that produces a data item indicating whether an organism has ever had a particular disease, lifestyle factor, immune exposure, or medical procedure.

label: disease severity assay
definition: An assay that measures the severity of a disease in an organism.

label: genetic characteristic assay
definition: An assay that produces information about a genetic characteristic of an organism.

label: blood type assay
definition: An assay that classifies an organism's blood within one or more blood group classification systems by identifying antigens present in the blood.

label: capillary electrophoresis mass spectrometry assay
definition: A mass spectrometry assay where a sample mixture is first separated by capillary electrophoresis before being analysed by mass spectrometry.

label: neurite outgrowth assay
definition: A cell differentiation assay that detects neurite outgrowth and/or branching

label: neuronal differentiation assay
definition: A cell differentiation assay that measures differentiation of neurons.

label: oligodendrocyte differentiation assay
definition: A cell differentiation assay that measures differentiation of oligodendrocytes.

label: regulation of synapse maturation assay
definition: A cell differentiation assay that measures synapse formation and maturation using antibodies to protein found in synaptic puncta.

label: Ames assay
definition: A cell based DNA damage assay that uses several constructed bacterial strains to detect mutations.

label: micronucleus assay
definition: A cell based DNA damage assay in eukaryotic cells that detects cytoplasmic micronuclei.

label: PIG-a assay
definition: A cell based DNA damage assay in eukaryotic cells that detects loss of function through mutation of the X-linked (single-copy) Pig-a gene.

label: cell viability assay based on detection of resorufin
definition: A cell viability assay using the NAD(P)H-aided conversion of resazurin to resorufin by metabolically active cells.

label: cell death assay using caspase abundance to detect apoptosis
definition: A cell death assay that uses fluorescence imaging-based detection of caspases involved in apoptosis

label: cell death assay
definition: A cell viability assay which measures the number or proportion of dead cells in a population.

label: cell viability assay based on detection of resorufin using fluorescence to qualtify the presence of resorufin.
definition: A cell viability assay based on detection of resorufin that uses fluorescence to quantify resorufin

parents.label: cell viability assay based on detection of resorufin

label: cell death assay detecting lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release
definition: A cell death assay that measures the release of intracellular LDH.

label: cell death assay detecting lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release using absorbance detection.
definition: A cell death assay detecting lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release by absorbance of substrate

parents.label: cell death assay detecting lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release

label: ovulation assessment in rodent assay
definition: A histological assay that measures the number of corpora lutea (UBERON:0002512) in the ovary of an organism; corpora lutea develop from the postovulatory follicle.

label: macroscopic examination of material anatomical entity assay
definition: An assay that performs a macroscopic assessment of a material anatomical entity using the sense of sight.

label: pathological macroscopic examination of specimen assay
definition: A macroscopic examination of material anatomical entity assay performed on a post-mortem anatomical specimen.

parents.label: macroscopic examination of material anatomical entity assay

label: estrous cycle assay based on tissue morphology
definition: A histological assay that evaluates cells in the vaginal endometrium to assess the estrous cycle phase the subject was in at the time of specimen collection.

label: organism development assay in late embryo
definition: An organism development assay performed with a late embryo stage subject.

label: pregnancy assessment based on tissue morphology assay
definition: A histological assay that measures the number of implantation sites in an organism.

label: cell death assay using  vital dye
definition: A cell death assay that uses the Trypan blue vital dye to stain cells which have lost membrane integrity.

label: neurite length assay
definition: A cytometry assay that uses a distance measurement assay to determine the length of a neurite.

label: neurite degree of arborization assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the degree of arborization, or branching, in neuronal processes

label: neurite count assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the number of neurites in a cultured specimen.

label: neuron count assay
definition: A cytometry assay that measures the number of neurons in a sample

label: cell-body-associated presynaptic puncta count assay
definition: A regulation of synapse maturation assay that determines the number of  synaptic puncta in the cell body compartment of a neuron.

label: dendrite-associated presynaptic puncta count assay
definition: A regulation of synapse maturation assay that determines the number of synaptic puncta in the dendritic compartment of a neuron.

label: synapse per neuron assay
definition: A regulation of synapse maturation assay that determines the number of synaptic puncta in a culture and normalizes it by the number of neurons in the culture.

label: absorbance quality detection assay
definition: An assay that measures the absorbance quality of the evaluant

label: hormone assay
definition: The analyte assay that measures the abundance of a hormone in a specimen.

label: chemiluminescent assay
definition: An analyte assay that detects a substance by measuring the release of light triggered by a chemical reaction.

label: electrochemiluminescence assay
definition: A chemiluminescent assay that detects a substance by measuring the release of light triggered by an electrochemical reaction.

label: proteomics by mass spectrometry assay
definition: A mass spectrometry assay that identifies and measures proteins.

label: metabolomics by mass spectrometry assay
definition: A mass spectrometry assay that identifies and measures metabolites.

label: cellular indexing of transcriptomes and epitopes by sequencing
definition: An assay performed on single cells that simultaneously measures transcript expression via single-cell RNA sequencing and profiles surface proteins via sequencing of DNA-barcodes attached to antibodies recognizing particular surface proteins from individual cells.

label: immune receptor repertoire profiling assay

label: antibody-dependent complement deposition assay
definition: An assay measuring antibody-dependent complement-dependent cytotoxicity.

label: bacterial flagellin detection in plasma assay

label: bacterial flagellin detection in feces assay

label: bacterial lipopolysaccharide detection in plasma assay
definition: An analyte assay measuring bacterial lipopolysaccharide in a plasma sample.

label: bacterial lipopolysaccharide detection in feces assay
definition: An analyte assay measuring bacterial lipopolysaccharide in a feces sample.

label: adenosine deaminase activity assay
definition: An analyte assay measuring adenosine deaminase activity in a sample.

label: pathogen neutralization assay
definition: An assay that measures neutralization of a pathogen.

label: bacterial neutralization assay
definition: A pathogen neutralization assay measuring neutralization of bacteria.

label: viral plaque assay
definition: An analyte assay measuring the number of discrete viral plaques.

label: analyte detection by flow based bead assay
definition: An analyte assay that uses beads to measure the concentration of an analyte with a flow cytometer.

label: urine opacity assay
definition: A histological assay with urine evaluant that measures opacity of the urine

label: urine color assay
definition: A histological assay with urine evaluant that measures color.

label: urine histological assay

label: color detection assay

label: opacity determination assay
definition: An assay that measures the opacity of the evaluant

label: length measurement assay

label: crown rump length

label: path length assay
definition: An assay that measures the distance traveled in a defined period of time.

label: cell migration assay

label: oligodendrocyte migration assay

label: radial glial migration assay

label: neuron migration assay

label: acidity quality assay

label: specific gravity assay

label: speed measurement assay

label: velocity measurement assay

label: luminescence detection assay

label: population count assay

label: neuron burst rate assay

label: neuron interburst interval assay

label: cell count assay
definition: An assay that measures the number of cells in a portion of a cell culture or tissue or bodily fluid

label: differential leukocyte count assay
definition: A hematology assay that measures the percentage of classes of leukocytes in a sample.

label: electrocardiogram assay
definition: An electrophysiology assay that measures heart activity using electrodes placed to detect electrical signals from the heart.

label: telemeter sensor detection assay
definition: An assay which uses an implanted telemeter to measure physiological data in a living organism and transmit the measures via radio waves to a recording device.

label: multi-electrode array assay
definition: A multi-unit recording assay using a multi-electrode array (MEA) on the surface of a well on a cell culture plate.

label: transepithelial / transendothelial electrical resistance (TEER) assay
definition: An extracellular electrophysiology recording assay to measure the integrity of a cell monolayer

label: count of multi-electrode plate electrodes detecting action potential assay
definition: A multi-electrode array assay that measures the number of electrodes in a well where the mean rate of action potentials is at least 5 spikes per minute.

label: count of multi-electrode plate electrodes detecting neuron burst assay
definition: A multi-electrode array assay that measures the number of electrodes in a well where the burst rate is at least 0.5 bursts per minute.

label: neural network spike rate assay

label: neural network spike duration assay
definition: A multi-electrode assay that measures the mean duration of events when multiple electrodes detect an action potential

label: count of multi-electrode plate electrodes detecting spike peak assay
definition: A multi-electrode array assay that measures the average number of electrodes detecting a network spike, measured at the peak of a network spike.

label: mean interspike interval in network spike
definition: A multi-electrode assay that measures the average interval between network spikes, events where multiple electrodes simultaneously detect an action potential.

label: bile acid concentration assay
definition: An analyte assay that measures the abundance of bile acid in a volume of sample.

label: urea nitrogen assay
definition: An analyte assay that measures the abundance of urea nitrogen.

label: urea nitrogen concentration assay
definition: A urea nitrogen assay that measures the abundance of urea nitrogen in a specimen

label: DNA damage comet assay

label: PCR-SSCP assay

label: tumor grading

label: assay detecting a molecular label
definition: An assay that detects the presence or a quality of a molecular label which is a proxy for the detection of the molecular target to which the label is attached

label: histological assay

label: substance detection assay
definition: An assay that detects a specified substance

label: longitudinal mass measurement assay
definition: An assay that measures the mass of a material at two or more time points

label: enzyme-linked immunospot assay

label: 3D structure determination assay
definition: An assay that determines the 3-dimensional configuration of an input material.

label: sequencing assay
definition: An assay the uses chemical or biochemical means to infer the sequence of a biomaterial
